# Copilot context

Read the repository root `AGENTS.md` and the nearest scoped `AGENTS.md` before editing. They are the source of truth; this file intentionally contains no duplicate project rules. Follow their verification commands and report actual results.

For Level 2/3 work, follow [the task-artifact workflow](../docs/agentic/README.md). Read the relevant `docs/agentic/tasks/<task-id>-<short-name>/` artifacts when supplied, or create them progressively as the guide requires, and honor its approval gates before implementation.
